title: Sagalee Ogummaa Gaaddidduu Keessatti
intro: Namni bara durii, hubannoo gadi fagootiin beekamu, jaarraa hedduuf sitti dubbata. Namni dhuunfaa kun raajii ta’uu isaa gonkumaa hin himanne, ta’us ogummaan waaqaa jechoota isaanii keessaa yaa’a ture. Warra hambaa qajeelfama bara baraa dhiisee deeme, gorsi isaanii onnee miliyoonaan lakkaa’aman keessatti eegamee, dubbifamee fi irratti xiinxalamee hanga har’aatti jira.
clues: Kennaa waaqummaa adda na godhe argadhe - ogummaan akka malee gadi fagoo ta'ee fi seenaa keessatti amala koo isa ibsu ta'e.
Ani ergamaas ta'ee ergamaa hin turre - lubbuu hubannoo gadi fagoo fi hubannoo addunyaa irratti eebbifamte qofa.
Walitti dhufeenyi koo inni guddaan mucaa koo wajjin kan ture siʼa taʼu, karaa hidhata kanaan ergaan koo inni hunda caalaa waaraa taʼe naaf darbe.
Nama waan hundumaa naaf kenne galata akka qabaadhu gaafadhe, of tuulummaa fi of tuulummaa irraas akeekkachiise.
Waa'ee ulfaatina hojii gatii sanyii sanaaficaa tokkoo illee, fi barbaachisummaa gad of qabuun sagalee gadi buusuun barsiiseera.
Qur’aana keessatti boqonnaan tokko maqaa koo kan qabu yoo ta’u, gorsi ani ilma koo jaallatamaatiif kenne bara baraan kan eegamedha.

trial.label: Yaali/Taatee
options: Ogummaa kennuu fi mucaa ofii gorsuu
Badiisaa jalaa miliquuf meeshaa guddaa ijaaruu
trial.answer: Ogummaa kennuu fi mucaa ofii gorsuu

location.label: Qaama Ijoo
options: Jechoota ogummaa yeroo hin qabne kan ilma ofiitiif dubbataman
Teessoo ajaa'ibaa kan feesbuukii irraa hojjetame
location.answer: Jechoota ogummaa yeroo hin qabne kan ilma ofiitiif dubbataman

outcome.label: Bu'aa
options: Ogummaa kennee fi galata Rabbiif ajaje
Whale guddaa tokkoon liqimfamee haaromfamee ba'e
Obboloota hinaaffaa qabaniin boolla bishaanii keessa darbatame
outcome.answer: Ogummaa kennee fi galata Rabbiif ajaje

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
